title: Results or home lessons are not syncing
content: Use this troubleshooting record when saved results or assigned home lessons differ between devices. Offline completion can wait for a connection. A replaced assignment cannot complete over the newer assignment. Preserve local work; do not clear app data or reinstall as a speculative fix.

symptoms: Saved results do not appear on the other device.
A completed home assignment still appears pending.
questions: Is the device connected to the internet?
Was this home lesson replaced by newly sent work?
Does this affect one learner or multiple learners?
safe_steps: Check whether another website opens on the same device.
Keep the saved work and the app data intact while reconnecting.
Check the currently assigned lesson rather than reopening an older notification.
collect_if_unresolved: Product and app version on each device.
Whether the issue started offline and whether a replacement lesson was sent.
Sanitized on-screen message and activity date; no learner identity.
